turns.text: Hi, I need to change the delivery address. The parcel should not go to the address I used at checkout.

Hello, I can help with a delivery address change. Please send me the order number (SC- followed by four digits) and the email address you used when you placed the order. I also need the new address you want the parcel sent to.
The order is SC-3360, the email is nora.blake@example.com, and the new address is Str. Exemplu 22, Sibiu.

Thank you, Nora. Order SC-3360 has already shipped, so I cannot change its delivery address. I have passed your question to a colleague, who will take over the chat. You can follow the parcel with the tracking link: https://curier.example/track/SC3360

rule.ro: Adresa de livrare se poate schimba până la expedierea comenzii. Schimbarea trebuie aprobată de echipă.
rule.en: The delivery address can change until the order ships. Staff must approve the change.

input.summary: Customer Nora Blake (verified with SC-3360 and email) asked to change the delivery address to Str. Exemplu 22, Sibiu. Order is already shipped, so check_policy returned not allowed (already_shipped) and no request was filed. Customer may ask staff about the shipped parcel.
